projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (LLM.int8) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency using pynvml and psutil (performance optimization, profiling).

Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with <1% accuracy degradation — near-lossless compression demonstrating engineering trade-off analysis (metric: 55% memory reduction, metric: <1% accuracy loss).
